text:
alex: CI alert — nightly-smoke on h100 pool red, lots of OOMs and a couple kernel launch XIDs. link: https://ci.internal/runs/4682 :grimacing:

mira: saw it, grabbed logs. jobs failing are the quant-inference smoke and the long-seq e2e. quick glance shows driver mismatch warnings + OOM on warmup.

jon: can someone paste the top error? I can't access the UI from home.

alex: paste from job 4682-3: 
```
[2026-03-14T02:11:05Z] Error: cuda_driver_init failed: CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN (module load: libcuda.so.1: version `CUDA_12.2' not found)
[2026-03-14T02:11:12Z] FATAL: OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate 1.5GiB during KV cache init
Xid 31: GPU hang detected
```

mira: that libcuda note suggests the image might have been rebuilt against a different toolkit. image tag: inference-nightly:20260314.

lee: I repro'd locally on a smaller a100 node — warmup spikes then OOM. If driver is newer than runtime, PTX JIT can blow up memory.

jon: is this the same as yesterday's canary that passed? we rolled a kernel patch last night.

alex: yesterday canary used inference-nightly:20260313 which passed. current stack shows driver 535.x vs container cuda runtime 12.1. mismatch.

mira: plan: (1) pause rollout of inference-nightly:latest to h100 pool (2) requeue a targeted rerun with pinned image 20260313 (3) spin a canary with updated driver shim if needed.

jon: +1. I can trigger the targeted rerun and pin to the older image. can we also request a bisect across the last two commits to the quant kernel? might be separate.

lee: i'd hold the bisect until the rerun completes — if the rerun passes with the old image then it's driver image skew, not the quant changes.

mira: CI job to rerun: https://ci.internal/runs/4682/try-pin-20260313 — requested with priority 'canary'. ci-bot: can you enqueue?

ci-bot: Job queued: inference-nightly-pin-20260313 (job id 4690). Estimated start: 8m. Notifying eng-ml-oncall.

alex: oncall, if job 4690 fails similarly, we will need a bisect across image rebuilds and the quant kernel PRs. @sre-bot can you lock the h100 pool to avoid other canaries for 30m?

sre-bot: h100 pool marked maintenance for 30 minutes. No new canaries will land.

jon: while we wait, checklist for bisect if needed: ensure artifacts uploaded (perf traces + nvprof), enable kernel debug env VARs, and preserve the failing node for postmortem.

lee: noted. also capture dmesg + nvidia-smi -q before we recycle.

mira: update: job 4690 started. I'll watch logs and post quick triage. :eyes:

alex: thanks — will follow. if 4690 passes we can rollback the image bump instead of doing a heavy bisect.

mira: quick log tail from 4690: warmup succeeded, no XIDs so far, test run engaging quant kernels. looks stable at 30s.

jon: great sign. keep it pinned for the next 10m. if green, we revert nightly:latest tag to 20260313 and open a postmortem about our image tagging checks.

alex: agreed. I'll draft the revert PR and a short playbook item to validate driver/runtime alignment in CI smoke.

mira: closing loop once full run finishes. thx everyone. :thumbsup:
